name: claude-pi
description: claude-pi: Claude Code with pi's lean harness, and any model beside Claude.

plugins.name: pi
plugins.description: Claude Code with pi's lean harness: five tools in full with pi's descriptions and rules, every other tool one ToolSearch away, bundled skills hidden from the model, CLAUDE.md as the only added context, and a trimmed system prompt. Works in Code Mode.

plugins.name: pi-models
plugins.description: Use any model served by an Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint (vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, a gateway) beside Claude: as the main model or as an agent.
